analysis:
Examined the new selected-model residency recovery (ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift), its hook into the model-switch settle predicate (ProviderLoop+ModelSwitch.swift:143), and the shutdown changes (ProviderLoop+Serve.swift:493, 519).

The recovery is local availability/memory logic. It touches no coordinator trust boundary, key material, attestation, authorization, or consumer plaintext. It does not add new network surface, and it does not alter encryption or cache-storage behavior, so T-041 is unaffected.

Recovery pauses during drain, updates, model switch, Autopilot lease or command, startup preload and in-flight loads (selectedModelRecoveryPauseReason, lines 151-163). It re-checks before taking ownership (lines 139-140) and again per victim before each unload (lines 275-282). It never evicts models in the ordinary selection, Autopilot pins, or models a request could load back (isProtectedFromRecoveryEviction, line 78). It loads with allowEviction:false (line 295). This limits races with model-switch and drain operations.

ModelSwitch adds `selectedModelRecovery.attempt == nil` to modelSwitchMutationsSettled, so a switch drain waits for an in-flight recovery. The attempt Task is not cancelled by a switch. Pause reasons stop new attempts, and the drain loop is bounded by the request deadline, or by the coordinator-barrier 30s wait when no deadline is set. This is a minor liveness coupling, not a security issue.

Serve.swift: the in-flight recovery task is awaited during shutdown with the other preloads. The unload loop was replaced by unloadAllModelsForShutdown(), whose implementation was not supplied. I could not verify it preserves the previous semantics: wait for pending unloads, then unload all slots until empty, and fail closed on native MiMo shutdown. This is an unverified contract, and it affects the T-028 residual GPU memory exposure and T-029 resource release at shutdown.

Other unsupplied dependencies: SelectedModelRecovery (state and backoff), evictionExclusions, adoptionReleaseTime, releaseAdoptionForSelectedModelRecovery, and unloadModel(forEviction:).

No concrete regression was identified. Next pass should check unloadAllModelsForShutdown and the recovery state type.
